title: Bryson Tiller Shares He Is Dropping First Single Off Next Project On September 8th
htmlContent:
Almost a year ago, Bryson Tiller jumped on Instagram Live to share with the world that his next album was on the way.

“I’m excited, I’m not going to stay on this for very long, but the album is on the way. The s*** is done a lot of s*** coming. To all the fans that got that number, I don’t remember the number,” said Tiller.

“I probably post it again soon, but if y’all got the number stay tuned, I’m going to do something really special. I mean really-really special, something f*** merch that you and only you. So, stay tuned coming real some, and that’s just for y’all. So, much love to y’all and talked to soon. Peace!”

On Friday afternoon, the Overtime artist posted a video on his Instagram and shared that he will drop the first single off his upcoming album on September 8th.

"What up, world? It's your boy, I'm going to make this quick, but next week September 8th, I'm going to be dropping my new single," said Tiller.

"The first single to my new album, which we will talk about later, but I'm super excited about it. It has been a minute, and I have been waiting on this s*** to drop for while. That's it next week September 8th see y'all soon."

Earlier this year, Tiller partnered with baseball legend Ken Griffey Jr on the S24 x TrapSoul Capsule Collection.
